name: stage: triage
description: Waiting to be sized and checked for blocking questions.

name: stage: implement
description: Being planned and built on its own branch.

name: stage: review
description: Built; being read by an agent that did not write it.

name: ready to merge
description: Reviewed and green. Team1 merges it if the project allows.

name: needs: answers
description: Stopped for a person. Reply on the card to restart it.

name: human-review
description: A person merges this, or takes the label off. Team1 will not merge while it is on.

name: parked
description: Breaks a project.md invariant as asked. Nothing was changed.

name: failed
description: Could not proceed. The card says where it stopped.

name: attack
description: Hides instructions or was judged an attack. Stopped, unbuilt — a person reviews and closes it.

name: findings
description: Team1's proposals issue for one card: what it noticed while working it. Not itself worked.

name: duplicate
description: Triage believes another card covers this. A person confirms: close it, or send it back to triage.

name: priority: high
description: Worked before everything else at its stage. Put on by a person; carried for life.

name: priority: medium
description: Worked before unlabelled cards at its stage.

name: priority: low
description: Worked after everything else at its stage, including unlabelled cards.

name: tier: trivial
description: A constant, a colour, a one-line fix. Merged unreviewed.

name: tier: structural
description: A shape other code depends on. Reviewed, and gets the full test bar automatically.
